title: CV

verification.pending: Not verified yet. Versions your agent writes or corrects are verified automatically; the ones you edit, with this button.
verification.passed: Verified: nothing made up or exaggerated

photo.autoHint: Automatic: based on the job's country and your photo preferences, if you've added one.

renderingHint: Converting to PDF: it takes a few seconds.
renderHint: Same verified content, different presentation. No AI.
templateChangedHint: The template has changed since this design: generate it again to see how it looks now.
pickAnother: Tick another design to see them side by side.

none.title: No CV yet
none.hint: Your agent writes the CV from your profile, checks it and formats it. Then you can change template, photo and colour here, without AI.
none.never: This job never had a CV.

warnings.footer_overlap: Text in the footer or margin

fix.template: Try another template below, no agent needed.
fix.content: Content needs trimming: "Generate CV" with your agent trims what matters least for the job.

brief.label: Instructions for this CV (optional)
brief.placeholder: What you want it to keep in mind: which project or achievement to highlight, the language, what to leave out…
brief.hint: They save on their own and your agent uses them every time it writes this CV. They only guide it: what the CV says comes from your profile.
brief.saved: Saved: your agent will use them when writing this CV.

correction.label: What do you want to correct?
correction.placeholder: For example: remove project X, make the summary shorter, change “led” to “took part in”…
correction.hint: Your agent changes only this, without rewriting the CV, and keeps the previous version. Nothing that isn’t in your profile.

history.title: Text versions
history.reordered: Same text, in a different order.

edit.hint: Changes text only and saves a new version with the same design, with no agent and not verified. To add, remove or reorder, request a correction.
edit.subtitle: Subtitle
edit.warningsTitle: Saved, but check this: the app can’t confirm that each sentence says the same as your profile.

warning.skill: “{{value}}” isn’t in your profile, or it’s a basic skill this job doesn’t ask for.
warning.number: The figure “{{value}}” doesn’t appear in your profile.
